title: Megurine Luka — Accept Your Regrets〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Okay, one, two, three, four!
Five, six, seven, eight!

rows.Speaker: Len & Miku
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four!
Five, six, seven, eight!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wonderful! You two are dancing in perfect sync♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for agreeing to help us practice, Luka! We couldn't have done this without you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Now we just gotta fine-tune the timing for each move and make sure we move our hands at the same angle.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes! Let's keep doing our best, Len!
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, you guys! We came to practice!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! Welcome, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
We were also just having dance practice.
Come join us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we'd love to.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is Haruka somewhere else today?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes, she's at the TV station.
She said she'd come join us if she has time, but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The TV station...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (She must be trying to find out why they stopped receiving offers.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I am happy that we've started receiving offers again...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But the reason why we stopped receiving offers after Idol Lovers still remains a mystery.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I've been a little worried about her ever since she said that.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (But not enough to go tell the others about what happened right away. For now, I'll keep an eye on how things unfold.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, Miku, can you take Haruka's place?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay♪ I'll do my best to look as sharp as her when she dances!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Luka, let's watch them dance together!
What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, let's.
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hello! Thank you for having us again today!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, thank you for coming!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, we want you all to see how we do that dance now♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We've become so good that Miku and Len may have a hard time keeping up with us now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we heard that MEIKO was a really tough coach! So, why don't you show us before we start practicing together?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No Haruka again today, I see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Unfortunately...
But she has been investigating very thoroughly for us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Investigating? You mean how you stopped getting offers?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. She's been asking basically everyone she knows to see if they can provide her with any clues.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, would it be alright for me to go see her?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? That should be fine, but why do you ask now, all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because it feels like I haven't spoken to her in ages♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It should be okay to talk to her whenever she's in her room or over at the MORE MORE HOUSE.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're acting all playful, but something tells me that you're actually worried about her...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
What makes you say that?
I really do just want to talk to her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, when you do talk to her, see how she's doing for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: While we've been getting ready for our streams and show appearances, Haruka's been investigating nonstop.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which probably hasn't been easy for her...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: On top of that, I feel like she's been keeping her distance in order to allow us to focus on our own work.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But if what you're saying is true, then that means we have to make the most of every second that she's giving us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, Luka, we feel a lot better knowing that you have Haruka's best interests in mind.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that case, when I do go talk to her, I'll try to see how she's doing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And if it turns out she isn't having trouble, I'll have a long, long chat with her, for a change of pace♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A change of pace for who?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, for Haruka, of course.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What? There's no way.

rows.Speaker: Airi, Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.
